scope: Proposition 14.2 (Balanced patch profiles) of the manuscript “The hypercube Ramsey number has linear order” (preprints/The-hypercube-Ramsey-number-has-linear-order-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 171 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7d4b26e897038267), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 124. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In the capped product domain of cluster-patch input laws and price simplices, there is a parameter point (π, z) such that πi = πout i and zi maximizes z′ i · πi over ∆(Yi), for every patch i. At this point, max πi ≤ 11/Mi. (14.4) Every cleaned corner support used with positive probability satisfies Lemma 13.4 at the realized comparison laws (πi)i. Their union in a patch, called its envelope, inherits the degree and row-tail bounds; clique exclusion is asserted separately on each corner support. In low cluster mode the unrestricted mean satisfies ∥π0 i − πi∥TV ≤ exp(−h 1+Ω(1) i ) + O(h2 i √ ϵi).
